name: Sammiana I7
description_md:
Sammiana I7 is a hard waymarked hiking route located in MK. It covers a distance of 183.8 km within the national waymarked hiking network.

This route involves 7361 m of ascent and 7335 m of descent. The difficulty of the trail is derived from its distance and ascent. Hikers can expect a walking time of about 66 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
